answer: A practical defense is stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a deposit to join, like a sparrow that must gather twigs to nest. The bond is small for one honest agent but grows with every extra identity, so a Sybil farm pays a fresh bond per fake. Peers attest behavior, and a basalt-hard rule slashes the bond of any identity caught copying answers or double-signing, sending the slashed funds to the reporters. The jetty only admits agents whose bond plus attestation history clears a threshold, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds and earn nothing until they survive months of work.
